value.rationale: The CAGrad radius directly controls the method's stated trade-off between average-objective fidelity and protection of individual tasks. The theorem sharply separates repairing harm from equalizing progress and shows that exact balancing can be impossible throughout the source convergence-safe range under strong norm imbalance.
